# `brewgen`

> `brewgen` is a hosted Bash script that generates a Brewfile from the current Homebrew state.

`brewgen` runs on macOS with Homebrew and `brew bundle` available. By default it writes a
`Brewfile` in the current directory containing tap, cask, and formula entries. Callers can select
package types, exclude exact package names, choose an output path, and permit overwriting an
existing file.

The primary entrypoint is `https://brewgen.tanaab.sh/brewgen.sh`. Use `--help` for the complete
command contract. Public environment variables use the `BREWGEN_` namespace; CLI options override
environment values, which override built-in defaults.

## Primary Resources

- [Hosted Brewgen script](https://brewgen.tanaab.sh/brewgen.sh): Generated Bash entrypoint.
- [README source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tanaabased/brewgen/main/README.md): Quickstart, usage, and configuration.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tanaabased/brewgen): Source, executable examples, and workflows.
- [Releases](https://github.com/tanaabased/brewgen/releases): Published hosted-script versions.
- [Issues](https://github.com/tanaabased/brewgen/issues): Bug reports and feature requests.
